assumptions.text: A1. Patent term taken as 20 years from earliest non-provisional filing for the 'probably expired' note, ignoring adjustment, extension and lapse.
A2. Contemplated product taken as the principal-embodiment valve core ([0107]-[0141]) sold as a replacement core and in a Presta-pattern tyre valve.
A3. No legal status, family or claim amendment of any saved document has been checked.
A4. Country of manufacture unknown; manufacture is itself an infringing act where it takes place.

open_questions.text: Q1. Counsel: commission professional FTO search and claim charts for items 1, 3 and 4, including legal status of US11179979B2, US11549591B1 and its continuations US11808363B1 and US12104701B1, and EP3171056A1.
Q2. Requester: where and by whom will the valve core and NiTi seat ring be made?
Q3. Requester: will the product be sold as a replacement core, a complete tubeless valve kit, or pre-fitted in tubes or wheels?
Q4. Counsel: extend the search to CN, TW, DE and JP utility models and commercial sealant-resistant valve-core products.
